fact.claim: Storage Gateway achieves high availability on VMware through continuous health checks connected to the VMware monitoring service: during a hardware, software or network failure, VMware triggers a gateway restart on a new host or on the existing host if it is still operational, and users and applications experience up to 60 seconds of downtime during the restart. Storage Gateway high availability can be enabled in clustered VMware vSphere environments that have VMware HA enabled and shared volume storage available.
fact.question: How does Storage Gateway provide high availability?

qualifiers.scope: Storage Gateway high availability on VMware
qualifiers.condition: clustered VMware vSphere environment with VMware HA enabled and shared volume storage available

evidence.quote: Storage Gateway achieves high availability by running a series of continuous health-checks against the operation of the gateway that connect to the VMware monitoring service. During a hardware, software, or network failure, VMware will trigger a gateway restart on a new host or on its existing host if the host is still operational. At a maximum, users and applications will experience up to 60 seconds of downtime during a restart.
